sophia: onboarding columba-13b:int4v3 — longprefill sanity run shows repeating tokens / misalignment after ~16k tokens. filing here for triage.
raj: ok, does it reproduce locally or only on canary?
sophia: only on our quant canary so far. baseline fp16 run is clean.
mika: can you dump the kv index + pos metadata around the boundary? use `kvdump --tokens 16374:16396`
sophia: kvdump excerpt:
```
16374 shardA idx=16374 key=0x9a7f... len=2048
16375 shardA idx=16375 key=0x9a8b... len=2048
16376 shardA idx=16376 key=0x9a9c... len=2048
16377 shardA idx=16377 key=0x9adf... len=2048
16378 shardA idx=16378 key=0x9b00... len=2048
16379 shardA idx=16379 key=0x9b11... len=2048
16380 shardA idx=-16356 key=0x0000... len=0   <-- wrap
16381 shardA idx=-16355 key=0x0000... len=0   <-- wrap
```
```
sophia: looks like an index flip / signed wrap exactly at 16380
jen: -16356 is suspiciously like signed16 overflow after subtracting a window_base (we used to pack delta as int16 in quant path)
raj: did int4v3 change packing layout compared to int4v2?
sophia: yes, int4v3 switched to compact packing for keys and started using a 2-byte delta in the packing shim to save memory on GPU transfers
mika: that would make positive deltas > 32767 problematic, but we're hitting 16k, not 32k. maybe delta is computed as token_index - window_end and becomes negative then cast to int16 incorrectly.
ops-bot: [run 2025-03-04T02:12:11Z] scheduled: longprefill-canary-columba (id: 9902)
raj: hypothesis: packing uses signed int16 for deltas; when window_base moves the delta becomes negative and wraps because we cast after subtraction. quant kernel assumes unsigned delta.
sophia: quick local patch: change packing to encode delta as u32 and keep backward-compatible header flag. applied to my branch.
sophia: local repro after patch -> no wrap at 16k, generation matches fp16 baseline up to 20k tokens
jen: nice. can you open a PR and run CI? include a tiny compatibility flag and a runtime assert that checks delta range > -100000 and < 100000 to catch encoding issues earlier.
mika: also add a debug metric to track any post-prefill kv entries with len==0 or key==0x0000
sophia: PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/5910 - change packing to u32-deltas, compatibility header, delta-range assert, kv-liveness metric
ops-bot: [run 2025-03-04T02:25:00Z] started: CI longprefill (id: 9903)
sophia: CI run looks good so far. loss traces/rouge match baseline at 16,380 and 16,400 checkpoints.
raj: one more check — did the rot_scale fallback behavior change for int4v3 kernels? earlier we saw rot_scale fallbacks on some shards in other models causing subtle alignment diff.
sophia: i grep'd the kernel logs — rot_scale forced to 0.995 on some shards that used a legacy kernel, but that didn't coincide with the exact wrap window. still worth normalizing.
jen: mitigation plan: land packing fix + normalize rotary scale to 1.0 for the canary shard set and add an integration test that runs a longprefill across 24k tokens in CI weekly.
mika: adding a monitor: if any kv index < 0 OR key==0x0000 after prefills => fail CI and create paging alert.
ops-bot: [metric] kv-liveness: 0 anomalies in current run
sophia: rolling patch to canary now. will post final bench tomorrow. thanks all :rocket:
raj: add a short note to the model-onboarding checklist about "avoid signed 16-bit deltas in packing; prefer 32-bit or explicit sign handling"
sophia: will do.
